providers.title: The character criterion
providers.scope: Assume (KR) (Kirchberg-Rørdam; not proved in the programme). A unital separable C*-algebra A is Z-stable if and only if its central sequence algebra F_omega(A) has no characters.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The finite theorem
providers.scope: Every nonzero unital C*-algebra without characters has a finite maximal tensor power that receives a unital homomorphism from I(2,3); proved in the last lesson of the course.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Infinite tensor powers
providers.scope: Assume (DT) (Dadarlat-Toms; not proved in the programme). The infinite minimal tensor power of a unital separable C*-algebra without characters is Z-stable.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Maximal tensor products
providers.scope: Universal property, injective commuting legs, regrouping, functoriality, the quotient onto the minimal tensor product, and unital commuting restrictions of irreducible representations.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Irreducible representations of I(2,3)
providers.scope: They have dimension 2, 3 or 6; I(2,3) and its quotients are subhomogeneous and have no characters.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Separable reduction
providers.scope: A nonzero unital C*-algebra without characters contains a separable unital C*-subalgebra without characters.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Commuting copies
providers.scope: For a separable unital subalgebra D of F_omega(A), every finite maximal tensor power of D maps unitally into F_omega(A).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exact cuts
providers.scope: If a is Cuntz below b, then (a - delta)_+ = z*z with zz* in the hereditary subalgebra of b.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Gram maps
providers.scope: Contractions with x_i x_j* = delta_ij h define a completely positive order-zero map on M_q with a supporting homomorphism into the bidual.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Commuting Gram maps and I(2,3)
providers.scope: Order-zero maps on M_3 and M_2 with commuting ranges and complementary units give a unital homomorphism from I(2,3).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The Rørdam-Winter criterion
providers.scope: If orthogonal positive contractions a_1 = w*w and a_2 = ww* satisfy 1 - a_1 - a_2 Cuntz below (a_1 - eps)_+, there is a unital homomorphism from I(2,3); in every unital C*-algebra.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A unitary in the bidual
providers.scope: A unitary path in the unitization of the section algebra D_2 is carried to a unitary W of the bidual that intertwines gamma on both sides.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The weighted flip
providers.scope: k(1-k) sigma(y) W* = W* phi(Q(d) sigma(y)), which makes the two order-zero maps commute.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Independence in commuting factors
providers.scope: Products of linearly independent families from commuting factors are linearly independent.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Represented blocks
providers.scope: In an irreducible representation of a maximal tensor product, the von Neumann algebras generated by blocks of legs are commuting factors.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A detecting space
providers.scope: An algebra without characters has a finite-dimensional real space of self-adjoint elements that contains a noncommuting pair in every unital representation.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Real labels
providers.scope: Arrays whose images under all tensor products of rank-2 maps are linearly independent exist, by Sard's theorem.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Labels
providers.scope: Self-adjoint elements of a tensor power whose images are linearly independent in every irreducible representation of every larger tensor power.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Full elements
providers.scope: An element is full if and only if it is nonzero in every irreducible representation.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A full square-zero element
providers.scope: A finite maximal tensor power of an algebra without characters contains a full element w with w^2 = 0.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The cone homomorphism
providers.scope: A unital homomorphism from the matrix cone into a tensor power with full first corner.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The cube
providers.scope: The maximal tensor power C^k of the matrix cone is the algebra of continuous M_2^k-valued functions on the cube with scalar factors on the coordinate faces.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The matrix simplex
providers.scope: A continuous family of unital embeddings of M_2 into M_2^k over the simplex, using only the factors with positive weight.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: From a full cone to I(2,3)
providers.scope: A unital homomorphism from the cone with full first corner gives a unital homomorphism from I(2,3) into a finite tensor power.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
